chapter.heading: How Long, O LORD? For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
How long,
O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

How long
must I wrestle in my soul,with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?

Consider me
and respond, O LORD my God.Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,

lest my
enemy say, “I have overcome him,”and my foes rejoice when I fall.

But I
have trusted in Your loving devotion;my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.

I will
sing to the LORD,for He has been good to me.
